eventDetail.scope: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Computer Engineering, Digital Economy and Artificial Intelligence (CDEAI 2026) is a prestigious event organized by Guangzhou Institute of Science and Technology with a motivation to provide an excellent international platform for the academicians, researchers, engineers, industrial participants and budding students around the world to share their research findings with the global experts. CDEAI 2026 will be held in Changchun, China during November 28-30, 2026.
